title: Parent withdraw/releaseFromParent burn full shares but can underpay on rounding
root_cause: withdraw burns roundUp(assets) and releaseFromParent burns full lockedShares, but the payout is min(value,balance) after _withdrawFromChildren which does a single proportional, per-child-floored pass (no remainder loop), guarded only by a +10 wei tolerance -> bounded dust underpayment.
attacker_capabilities: exit when parent idle is short and children are pulled proportionally

severity_justification.program_table_mapping: see official program impact table (not bundled)

bounty_program_mapping.scope_reference: Cartha contest (cartha-vaults-main @ 4c51f2a); official scope list not bundled with PoC package.

call_trace: user exits requiring a pull from children
_withdrawFromChildren floors each child's proportional pull (single pass)
full shares burned but payout = min(value, balance) -> caller receives slightly less

state_transition.after: shares for `assets` burned; payout < `assets` by rounding dust

asset_delta: Bounded dust loss to the withdrawer (retained by vault / remaining holders).
reproduction_steps: code analysis — see report.md + vulnerable/ source

defense_analysis.why_it_fails: tolerates ~10 wei; per-child floors can still leave a small remainder

assumptions: perp deployment with 0xM pool wired (reader/oracle set)
